hash: SHA256 UTF8 A03|42|userId|movieId; lowercase hex ascending; movieId ascending tie
eligibility: at least one rating>=4 and at least two total ratings
split: one minimum-hash positive removed per eligible user, single global train; all others retained
candidateUniverse: entire catalog minus user's TRAIN-rated movies
sort: unrounded score descending, numeric ID ascending
failures: retain and report; count as miss and zero-output
